briefings.title: Daniel Ek: Life After Spotify, Broken Healthcare Incentives, Catching Disease Early & AI's Potential
briefings.tldr: Daniel Ek reflects on building Spotify and introduces Neko Health, a vertically integrated preventative health startup offering $499 annual scans, while discussing the future of AI, compute infrastructure, and healthcare incentives.

briefings.title: Teaching LLMs to Speak Spotify — Yves Raimond & Jacqueline Wood, Spotify

people.name: Yves Raimond
people.role: SVP and GM of AI & Personalization, Spotify

briefings.tldr: Spotify turned its recommendation engine into an LLM-native system called the "Large Taste Model," which now powers daily experiences for 1 in 4 US premium subscribers using a four-stage training recipe named NEO.

briefings.title: Keynote Interview with Alex Norström of Spotify | FT Session at Cannes Lions
briefings.tldr: Spotify is actively pivoting its platform away from passive, dopamine-driven vertical scrolling toward high-value, interactive user experiences and real-world event integration.
